text: To deal with offenders with mental disorder, the administrative involuntary hospitalization (AIH) scheme was adopted in Japan in 1950. However, its outcomes as well as standard of AIH adaptation remain obscure. Recently we developed a training program for improving the skills for AIH decision-making for early-career psychiatrists. The aim of this pilot study is to implement and investigate the effectiveness of this program.
source_label: Developing a training program of knowledge and skills in the context of administrative involuntary hospitalization: a pilot trial
